set.body:
Problem: DataSelection.All currently resolves to all spatial voxels, but masked latent/shared-basis backends only have an active readable voxel domain. A valid sparse latent backend can therefore reject its own default read.

Work: introduce an explicit typed voxel domain contract, such as full-space vs active/readable voxels, and make default reads unambiguous. Preserve global voxel indices in FmriSeries while making backend-readable feature sets inspectable.

Acceptance: dense full-space backends, masked latent backends, and VoxelSampleMap behavior are covered by shared tests; default read either returns active voxels or requires an explicit full-space request by type/API; datasetJVM/test and datasetJS/test pass.
set.title: Dataset: define voxel-domain and default-read contract
